name: Floor
role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp

spec.name: Floor
spec.role: floor plate under the car with rear diffuser ramp
spec.notes: Thin flat plate X -4300 to -400, Y ±800, Z 0-30; top face Z=30 carries the monocoque. Simplified side edges: chamfered/tapered outer edges and slightly tapered front corners in plan. Rear diffuser ramp: wedge X -3700 to -4300, Y ±500, rising from Z=30 at X=-3700 to Z=230 at rear edge, behind the monocoque rear face so no intersection. Single solid body.

script_body:
def build(part):
    L = part.p["length"]
    W = part.p["width"]
    T = part.p["thickness"]
    DL = part.p["diffuser_length"]
    DH = part.p["diffuser_exit_height"]
    C = part.p["edge_chamfer"]
    D1 = part.p.get("rear_taper_start", 2000.0)
    D2 = part.p.get("rear_taper_end", 2630.0)
    RHW = part.p.get("rear_half_width", 520.0)
    xf = -400.0
    xr = xf - L
    hw = W / 2
    # Plate cross-section (YZ) with chamfered top outer edges, extruded rearwards
    prof = part.section("x", xf, [
        (xf, -hw, 0), (xf, hw, 0), (xf, hw, T - C), (xf, hw - C, T),
        (xf, -hw + C, T), (xf, -hw, T - C)], "SK_floor_section")
    part.extrude(prof, -L, "EX_floor_plate")
    # Tapered front corners in plan
    for s, nm in ((1, "L"), (-1, "R")):
        sk = part.sketch(part.plane("z", 0), "SK_front_corner_" + nm)
        part.polygon(sk, [(xf + 10, s * (hw + 10), 0), (xf + 10, s * (hw - 150), 0),
                          (xf - 300, s * (hw + 10), 0)])
        part.extrude(part.profile(sk), T, "CUT_front_corner_" + nm, op="cut")
    # Rear narrowing in plan: full half-width for D1 from the front edge,
    # linear taper to RHW at D2 from the front edge, RHW to the rear end
    for s, nm in ((1, "L"), (-1, "R")):
        sk = part.sketch(part.plane("z", 0), "SK_rear_narrow_" + nm)
        part.polygon(sk, [(xf - D1, s * (hw + 10), 0), (xf - D1, s * hw, 0),
                          (xf - D2, s * RHW, 0), (xr - 10, s * RHW, 0),
                          (xr - 10, s * (hw + 10), 0)])
        part.extrude(part.profile(sk), T, "CUT_rear_narrow_" + nm, op="cut")
    # Rear diffuser ramp wedge
    xd = xr + DL
    sk = part.sketch(part.plane("y", 0), "SK_diffuser")
    part.polygon(sk, [(xd, 0, T - 10), (xr, 0, T - 10), (xr, 0, DH), (xd, 0, T)])
    part.extrude(part.profile(sk), "diffuser_width", "EX_diffuser", op="join", symmetric=True)

revision.change_summary: Rear floor narrowed in plan: half-width 800 for first 2000 mm from the front edge, linear taper to 520 at 2630 mm, then 520 to the rear end (3900 mm)
assumptions: New dims rear_taper_start=2000, rear_taper_end=2630 and rear_half_width=520 are positive distances measured rearwards from the front edge at X=-400; the script falls back to these values if the parameters are missing.
In the tapered and narrowed rear section the side edges are cut vertically, so the 20 mm top chamfer is not kept there; it stays on the front 2000 mm.

The diffuser (Y ±500) and the monocoque contact face (Y ±450) both lie inside the 520 mm rear half-width, so neither changes. The world envelope stays the same because the front section still reaches Y ±800.
